records.title: Self-Correcting VLA: Online Action Refinement via Sparse World Imagination
records.reason: Self-Correcting VLA is a robotics action-refinement/control method; fewer task steps are not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Integrating Domain-Specialized Language Models with AI Measurement Tools for Deterministic Atomic-Resolution Experimentation
records.reason: The paper integrates domain-specialized small LMs with microscopy tools for a scientific control application. Full text describes deterministic control and task-specific deployment but does not establish a general inference-serving efficiency technique or comparative systems evaluation.

records.title: Architecting AgentOS: From Token-Level Context to Emergent System-Level Intelligence
records.reason: AgentOS maps OS concepts to context management and coordination, but the primary text is a conceptual framework without empirical inference-efficiency evaluation; token-efficiency language is architectural advocacy rather than measured evidence.

records.title: Frayed RoPE and Long Inputs: A Geometric Perspective
records.reason: RoPE-ID targets long-context accuracy/generalization through positional-embedding changes; the abstract does not propose inference acceleration, serving, or compression.

records.title: TAPE: Tool-Guided Adaptive Planning and Constrained Execution in Language Model Agents
records.reason: TAPE improves agent planning success using tools, constrained decoding, and replanning; the abstract reports task quality, not efficiency gains.
